topic.title: Why Everyone Stopped Buying Crocs (and Then Didn't)

cta: Did you own a pair in 2007? Tell us in the comments
title: Why Everyone Stopped Buying Crocs (and Then Didn't)
description:
In 2007 the company behind the foam clog everyone called ugly sold {fact1}. A year later its maker lost {fact3} and warned, in its own annual report, that its auditors doubted it could continue as a going concern. Then the same shoe came back bigger than ever.
This is the cold open and the first chapter of the story, told from Crocs' own SEC filings.
